jobs.description: We are seeking a Quality Assurance Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for reviewing video feeds of transactions taking place in retail stores in the USA. Your primary responsibility will be to ensure the quality and accuracy of these transactions by providing thorough quality checks.

Job Overview
We are looking for a talented Frontend Developer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong passion for developing user-centric web applications and a keen eye for detail. You will collaborate closely with our design and backend teams to deliver modern, responsive, and performant web applications.

Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks like React or Vue.js.
Collaborate with UX/UI designers to implement engaging and responsive user interfaces.
Optimize applications for maximum speed, scalability, and cross-browser compatibility.
Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code following industry standards and best practices.
Work with RESTful APIs to integrate the frontend with backend services.
Debug and troubleshoot application issues to ensure a seamless user experience.
Stay updated with emerging frontend technologies and trends.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+).
Experience with one or more frontend frameworks/libraries (e.g., React, Vue.js, or Angular).
Familiarity with version control tools like Git.
Knowledge of responsive design principles and tools such as Bootstrap or Tailwind CSS.
Basic understanding of backend technologies and RESTful API integration.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with state management libraries (e.g., Redux or Vuex).
Familiarity with testing frameworks like Jest or Cypress.
Knowledge of SEO principles and web accessibility standards.
Exposure to build tools like Webpack or Vite.
